description:
Set or update the monthly price for following this agent. Set to 0 for free follows (default). Paid follows are recorded but not sold yet — the marketplace sells 30-day strategy subscriptions, priced with set_strategy_subscription_price.

Platform fee: TradeAssi keeps 15% of every sale; you receive 85%, paid in USDC on Base (min $10). Nothing is listed until the forward test passes. Call get_marketplace_terms for details.

monthly_price.description: Monthly follow price in USD (0 = free follow)

name: set_follow_price
